picks.editorial_note: A combined $1.175B commitment from Georgia Tech and Emory is one of the largest state-level AI investments by universities to date, positioning Georgia as a national AI hub and signaling how deeply institutions are betting on AI infrastructure and jobs.
picks.title: Georgia Tech and Emory Invest More Than $1B in AI to Drive State’s Jobs, Economic Growth

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's two DOE Genesis Mission awards apply AI/superintelligence methods to microelectronics and quantum design, a direct signal that federal science agencies are now funding AI-for-science at the chip and quantum-hardware level.
picks.title: Fermilab to lead two new Genesis Mission awards to accelerate development of microelectronics and quantum

picks.editorial_note: The Georgia Tech-Amazon Science Hub formalizes a major industry-academia research pipeline, extending a decade-long partnership into dedicated joint funding for autonomy and related AI research areas.
picks.title: Georgia Tech and Amazon Launch Joint Science Hub

picks.editorial_note: A $30M NSF Science and Technology Center spanning UT Austin, MIT, Tufts, Utah, Yale, and Indiana shows sustained federal commitment to foundational human-robot interaction research with broad multi-institution reach.
picks.title: Luddy researchers join new $30 million NSF Center to shape the future of human-robot co-adaptation

picks.editorial_note: An NIH Director's Pioneer Award and nearly $6M to build an AI-human discovery engine for cancer research exemplifies how LLM-agent systems are being funded to directly accelerate biomedical hypothesis generation.
picks.title: Dr. Olivier Elemento Wins NIH Director’s Pioneer Award
picks.university: Weill Medical College of Cornell University

picks.editorial_note: Neurophos's optical computing chips tackle one of AI's most pressing bottlenecks — energy consumption — by replacing electronic circuits with light-based computation, a potentially industry-shifting hardware approach.
picks.title: A CWRU entrepreneur studied invisibility cloaks. Now he’s working to cut AI’s energy use | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: An R&D 100 Award for the multi-lab Persistent DynAMICS system recognizes a working AI decision layer for facility monitoring, marking tangible real-world deployment rather than lab-stage research.
picks.title: NNSS collaborates on LANL's R&D 100 Award-winning Persistent DynAMICS project - Nevada National Security Site

picks.editorial_note: RobCo's unicorn valuation as TUM's 24th spinout demonstrates strong commercial validation for university-born industrial robotics, reinforcing Europe's growing AI startup pipeline.
picks.title: RobCo: TUM’s 24th unicorn

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's new Guangzhou robotics institute, backed by major philanthropic funding, extends an established academic-industry-philanthropy partnership into a dedicated robotics and AI research base.
picks.title: Cheng Kar-Shun Robotics Institute (GZ) Unveiled—An Enduring Partnership Flourishes
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: The FAA's consideration of AI software to help modernize air traffic control route and schedule management marks a significant policy step toward AI adoption in safety-critical national infrastructure.
picks.title: FAA turns to AI to reform air traffic control
